visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair wearing a black t-shirt with a white smiley face logo speaks directly into a small microphone. She is in a brightly lit indoor space with modern wooden textures and a pancake machine in the background. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a wall-mounted sign that displays the Japan Airlines (JAL) logo and the words 'Sakura Lounge' in English and Japanese. (3) The woman is back in frame, excitedly pointing towards a sleek, industrial-style automatic pancake machine with digital displays and 'FRESH • HOT • PANCAKES' text. (4) Close-up shot focusing on the machine's operation panel which reads 'LET THE COUNTDOWN BEGIN' and 'MAKE PANCAKES NOW' alongside a small serving plate. (5) The woman's hand is shown waving in front of a circular sensor on the machine labeled 'WAVE HAND' to trigger the cooking process. (6) Through a glass window on the machine, liquid batter is seen being dispensed from a nozzle onto a heated conveyor belt and then pressed by a mechanical plate. (7) Two perfectly round, golden-brown pancakes are shown sliding off the internal belt and dropping gently onto the rotating metal tray. (8) A wide shot shows a self-service counter stocked with various toppings including Hershey’s chocolate syrup, Smucker’s jam, butter, and a large pressurized can of whipped cream. (9) A close-up shows white whipped cream being sprayed in a swirl onto a white plate containing the freshly made pancakes. (10) The woman is seen sitting at a wooden table, using a metal fork to pick up a piece of the pancake covered in syrup. (11) She takes a bite, chews with a satisfied expression, and then gives an enthusiastic thumbs-up to the camera while smiling at the viewer. (12) The final shot shows a view through a large window of a Japan Airlines aircraft parked at an airport gate on a sunny day.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high energy and an enthusiastic tone in Mandarin over a cheerful acoustic guitar BGM. The BGM has a moderate tempo and a bright major-mode feel. (2) The speaker's narration continues rapidly as she describes the location. The guitar BGM remains constant. A subtle mechanical electronic beep is heard as she interacts with equipment. (3) The primary vocal pauses. The audio mix is dominated by the mechanical whirring of a motor and the metallic clicking of machine parts, followed by a soft thud. BGM continues. (4) The speaker returns at a high pitch, describing condiments. A sharp, continuous hissing sound occurs as whipped cream is sprayed. BGM provides a consistent rhythmic background. (5) Audible chewing and mouth sounds are followed by an enthusiastic vocal 'Hmm!' from the speaker. The music remains upbeat and prominent. (6) The speaker gives a final sign-off. The acoustic guitar BGM swells slightly in volume before a clean hard cut at the video's conclusion.
